title: Burnham’s climate dilemma
gist: Jacobs argues PM Andy Burnham's looming decisions on Jackdaw/Rosebank licences and especially on weakening the ZEV mandate are politically lopsided: Labour loses far more voters to the Greens and Lib Dems (who care about climate) than to Reform (who don't), so softening climate policy raises the risk of losing to the right. Nearly 75% of UK new-car sales in August were EV or hybrid, mostly imports, which is why British carmakers want the mandate slowed.
